_README: EXAMPLE ONLY. Copy this to ~/.watching-starter.json and put your own names in it.
The real file stays in your home directory and never enters this repository.
The build embeds whatever it finds there into the APK, so the app opens with
your household already set up instead of an empty screen.
The file is optional. Without it the app seeds one person called 'Me' plus the
common streaming services with no profiles, and you add the rest from the
Services and profiles screen. A guided first-run setup is planned for 3.0.
It seeds a FIRST run only. Once the app has written its own library.json,
editing this file does nothing - change things inside the app instead.
Every field except the names is optional. Colours are handed out in order when
you leave them out. 'default' names the profile the add screen starts on; if
you leave it out, the first profile listed is used.
